name: Kimi no Koe ga Kikoeru
source:
Naoya fails the university entrance examination, and starts to study at a preparatory school. He meets Sakura, Miyuki and Ouka there and enjoys his life. On the other hand, his father tells him to go and help the hotel, owned by his father. He also meets beautiful girls including Izumi, his childhood friend, there and enjoys his peaceful life. Naoya is busy with studying, loving and working! Sakura, Izumi and Miyuki... Love with girls, friendship with friends, long distance love and triple cohabitation...? What will happen to Naoya in the end?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
直也没能通过大学入学考试，于是进入补习学校学习。他在那里结识了樱、美由纪和樱花，享受着自己的生活。另一方面，父亲让他去帮忙经营自家的酒店。在那里，他又遇见了包括青梅竹马泉在内的美丽女孩，同样过着平静的生活。直也每天忙于学习、恋爱和工作！樱、泉与美由纪……与女孩们的爱情、与朋友们的友情、异地恋，以及三人同居……？直也最终会迎来怎样的结局？

[摘自ErogeShop]
